name: Quijorna (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, green and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Quijorna (an eagle on yellow and a tower on red above a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Quijorna; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Quijorna arms — eagle on yellow and tower on red above a tree
